stories.headline: EMA and FDA Set Common Principles for AI in Medicine Development
stories.summary: The European Medicines Agency and US FDA issued a joint framework establishing shared standards for AI use in drug development, clinical trial design, and regulatory submissions.
stories.why: A transatlantic regulatory alignment on AI in pharma removes a major barrier for global drug developers — one framework instead of two.

stories.headline: AI-Driven Drug Discovery Picks Up as FDA Pushes to Reduce Animal Testing
stories.summary: Reuters reports a surge in AI-powered preclinical research as the FDA signals openness to computational models replacing traditional animal studies in early-stage drug evaluation.
stories.why: Reducing animal testing requirements via AI could cut years and hundreds of millions from drug development timelines.

stories.headline: Merck and Mayo Clinic Team Up on AI-Driven Drug Discovery
stories.summary: The partnership will apply Mayo Clinic's de-identified patient data alongside Merck's compound libraries to train models that predict clinical outcomes earlier in the pipeline.
stories.why: Pairing a leading health system's real-world data with a top pharma's compound library represents a new template for AI drug discovery partnerships.

stories.headline: Roche and NVIDIA Deploy the Pharma Industry's Largest AI Factory
stories.summary: Roche has activated a large-scale NVIDIA DGX-powered compute cluster dedicated to molecular simulation, protein folding, and multi-omics analysis for oncology pipeline acceleration.
stories.why: Industrial-scale GPU compute inside a major pharma signals that AI drug discovery is moving from research project to core business infrastructure.
